method.clock: NTP-style: host sends ping(h0); pad replies with its clock p1; host receives at h3. offset=p1-(h0+h3)/2. Burst of 10 samples at connect and every 10 s; keep the 5 lowest-RTT samples; offset = median of those.
method.lag: lag_ms = t_cast_start_host - t_flick_host. t_flick_phone is the phone timestamp of peak forward pitch angular velocity; t_flick_host = t_flick_phone - offset. t_detect_host = when the host detector confirmed the peak (transport + detection, before rendering). t_cast_start_host is the host requestAnimationFrame timestamp of the first rendered frame showing the rod whip. release_lag_ms = first frame with the lure in flight minus bail release (phone time -> host time).
method.clocks: performance.timeOrigin + performance.now() on both devices (epoch ms).

pairing.note: ms = Show QR click -> first cast; scanToCastMs = phone joined -> first cast
